parsed.summary: No receipt-backed implementation evidence is visible. The only visible completion signal is a finalize action marked approved by gates, but it has no receipt_ref and does not prove QEMU is running, VNC 5901 is listening, nginx is on port 80, snapshot mode is enabled, programmatic keyboard control exists, or that Windows 3.11 reached the desktop.

Receipt-backed evidence of a programmatic keyboard control path configured and exercised against the VM
Receipt-backed evidence that the VM reached the Windows 3.11 desktop or equivalent desktop-ready state

Probe ports 5901 and 80 with a real service check and retain receipts
